title: input profile Mac or PC with Automatic

clauses.text: the input profile Automatic, Mac or PC is set on the Keyboard page and applies at once

steps.do: Open Settings, Keyboard and choose Mac, then choose PC, then choose Automatic.
steps.expect: Each choice applies without a restart and the help line under the control says what it does.

clauses.text: in the Mac profile Command does what Control does on a PC

steps.do: With the Mac profile set, in a text field, press Command+C, Command+V, Command+A, then Command+Left and Command+Right.
steps.expect: Command+C, Command+V and Command+A copy, paste and select all; Command+Left and Command+Right go to the start and the end of the line. Control+C stays Control+C.
Ctrl+Cmd+Q asks to sign out and Ctrl+Cmd+L locks the screen. Report what each does, since this mapping was changed in November.

clauses.text: three-finger drag is off by default and when it is on, three fingers drag with the left button

steps.do: Open Settings, Keyboard and check the three-finger drag switch (key J), which should be off. Turn it on, then move three fingers on the trackpad.
steps.expect: With it on, three fingers moving hold the left button and move the pointer, and lifting the fingers drops it. Turn it off again afterwards.
